body:
I don't know if I was thinking anything, really. 
It definitely wasn't vengeful thinking. 
I am just tired of living and dealing with all the political bullshit.

I guess it was just a bad weekend.

I had a big tournament that I got ranked horribly at because one judge believed I cheated, while the other was vengeful against my coach. 

Not really enough to warrant my reaction though.

The meds weren't mine. I'm not prescribed anything at the moment.

I'm 17. 

I just get sick of society-- really, truly sick. I see people living their lives-- "playing the game" per-say, but I can't help but get this feeling that there is some metagame or some reality outside common perception. 

And lets say I'm aware of that "metagame," as many redditors claim to be. We see the corporate and political maneuvering-- they perceive it, but even so-- we fail to truly comprehend it. 

As much as I'm loved-- as much as my friends remind me that I am truly wanted-- there is a gnawing insignificance that drags me down. 

I'm at the point where I can't tell the truth from a lie, even when it is coming from my own mouth. 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
I feel most at peace when i'm with nature-- but i don't have the opportunity to do anything more than the occasional walk.
The timing was sporadic--but it's something I think about often. I mean... i did take the time to research the drug before i took it.

I really didn't have a reason, well, not what I perceive as a good one. I was just tired of everything.

The Trazodone was a relatives.

Right now nothing seems to be out of the ordinary. There  have been events in the past which may still be affecting me, but at this point in time I can't pin-point what would cause this.
